hints.title: Single Pass Simulation
hints.text: The winner is initially arr[0]. When comparing against the next element, the larger value stays at the front.

hints.title: Consecutive Win Counter
hints.text: If the current winner beats the challenger, increment consecutive wins. If challenger wins, challenger becomes new winner with 1 win.

hints.title: Termination Condition
hints.text: If consecutive wins reach k, return the current winner. If you finish scanning the array, the maximum element seen will beat all remaining elements.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Actually rotating array elements repeatedly with k up to 10^9 takes O(k * N) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Simulating running comparisons in a single linear pass uses O(1) space and finishes in at most N steps.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate realizes that if no element achieves k consecutive wins before scanning the array, the overall maximum element will win forever.
complexity.notes: No actual array rotation is required.
